title: TrackScout photo upload meta
description: The `meta` part of POST /api/photo (multipart/form-data: a `meta` part with this JSON and a `photo` part with the JPEG). The reference server accepts the app's exact shape: question_id and place_key are always present, but `null` for capture-mode photos, which have no question. The position fields are the PRD's one 'send location' exception - they belong to the photo, and the reference server stores them only on its own machine.

photo_id.description: Client-generated UUID, the idempotency key: re-uploading a known id is a no-op that reports duplicate=true.

question_id.description: The question this photo was taken for; `null` in capture mode (owner photographs freely, the project's agents may attach it later).

place_key.description: The place as a `lat,lon` string; `null` when the photo has no place (capture at an unmodelled building).

building.description: Free-text place name, prefilled from the place the photo was taken for.

kind.description: What the photo shows - the app's capture-mode selector.

light.description: Light condition, auto-classified from the sun position at capture time; the owner can override it in the UI.

taken.description: Capture time, ISO 8601 with the local UTC offset, seconds precision, e.g. 2026-10-30T21:14:05+01:00 (a photo's EXIF time for imports). The server groups stored files by this date.

lat.description: Optional device position at capture (WGS-84); absent for imports without a location.

acc_m.description: Optional horizontal accuracy of the position, meters.

heading_deg.description: Optional compass heading the camera faced (0 = north, clockwise). Agents use it to tell whether a facade shot is straight-on.

pitch_deg.description: Optional camera tilt: positive up, negative down. Together with heading_deg it tells the agents how usable the shot is.

source.description: `camera` = taken in-app; `import` = added from the owner's photo library.

set_id.description: Optional: the guided photo set this shot belongs to (photo capture PRD 5.3), e.g. a storefront set.

set_step.description: Optional: the step within the set, e.g. the straight-on shot used to measure bay widths.
